title: Uncovering Hidden Behaviours in Language Models via Limited-Parameter Finetuning
abstract: arXiv:2611.30672v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models can have behaviours which only arise in hard-to-anticipate contexts. These hidden behaviours pose a challenge to alignment audits, which seek to uncover problematic model behaviour but are limited by the scenarios the auditor can anticipate. To address this challenge, we explore limited-parameter finetuning (LPF) on examples of a target behaviour. While training 3-25% of LoRA parameters, LPF reveals whether the model has a hidden behaviour, even when standard behavioural evaluations cannot. LPF succeeds on a suite of model organisms with hidden behaviours (8-14B parameters), and also surfaces naturally occurring hidden behaviours in open-weight models (27-35B parameters). LPF can thus distinguish between models which appear behaviourally identical to an auditor, and does not require the context in which the hidden behaviour surfaces. LPF provides a novel affordance that may be useful for auditing frontier AI models.

translated_title: 通过有限参数微调揭示语言模型中的隐藏行为
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型可能存在只在难以预料的情境中才会显现的行为。这些隐藏行为给对齐审计带来了挑战——对齐审计旨在发现模型的问题行为，但受限于审计者所能预见的场景。为应对这一挑战，我们在目标行为的示例上探索了有限参数微调（LPF）。在仅训练3-25%的LoRA参数的情况下，LPF能够揭示模型是否具有隐藏行为，即使标准的行为评估无法做到。LPF在一系列具有隐藏行为的模型生物（8-14B参数）上取得了成功，并且还显现出了开源权重模型（27-35B参数）中自然存在的隐藏行为。因此，LPF可以区分那些在审计者看来行为完全相同的模型，并且不需要知道隐藏行为出现的具体情境。LPF提供了一种新颖的能力，可能对前沿AI模型的审计十分有用。
tldr: 通过仅微调少量LoRA参数，LPF能在无需预知触发情境的情况下揭示语言模型的隐藏行为，从而区分表面上行为相同的模型，为AI对齐审计提供了一种全新的审计手段。
en_tdlr: Limited-parameter finetuning (LPF) of a small fraction of LoRA parameters can uncover hidden behaviours in language models without requiring knowledge of the triggering context, distinguishing models that appear behaviourally identical and offering a novel tool for AI alignment audits.
